newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks mixed in London, awaiting IBM's Q3.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks mixed in London, awaiting IBM's Q3.

text.p: U.S. stocks were narrowly mixed in quiet trading in London on Monday as investors awaited quarterly results from from International Business Machines Corp and Microsoft Corp, traders said.

Shares in IBM were off $1/4 at $129-1/8 in London, after having gained $3-7/8 in New York on Friday. IBM is expected to report its profits rose to $2.43 per share in the third quarter from $2.30 in the year ago period.
Shares in Microsoft were unchanged at $134-3/4 ahead of the release of its fiscal first quarter profits, seen at $0.90 per share, up from $0.78 in its 1995 first quarter.
Most other technology shares were holding near their New York closing levels, traders said.
"There's really not much interest at all in the techs. It's all very quiet," said one London broker.
Trading on Wall Street, he added, will be strongly influenced by IBM's results.
In other trading, shares in Caterpillar Inc gained $1/4 to $74-3/8 in London on positive comments from analysts after having reported a larger-than-expected increase in third quarter profits.
Shares in Philip Morris were unchanged at $92-1/4 in fairly active trading in London in the wake of a $5-1/8 decline in New York on Friday.
Tobacco shares tumbled on Friday following news that scientists claimed they had established a direct cellular link between smoking and cancer.

Shares in PepsiCo slipped $1/8 in London to $30-1/2 after rising on Friday amid rumours it was a possible takeover target. Shares in rival drinkmaker Coca Cola also lost $1/8 in London to $50, trimming Friday's $7/8-advance in New York.
In trading on Globex, the December S&P 500 futures contract eased, falling 0.70 point to 715.15 by 1036 GMT.
The December 30-year Treasury bond futures contract was up 3/32 at 111-12/32.
